## reference · pm-schedule-compliance-metric
* PM compliance measures the percentage of preventive maintenance tasks completed on schedule in a specified time period.
* The PM compliance formula is: **PM compliance = # of completed PMs ÷ # of scheduled PMs x 100**.
* World-class PM compliance is considered to be 90%.
* PM compliance does not account for late PMs or reactive maintenance tasks.
* The 10% rule can be used to factor in late PMs and avoid turning a blind eye to chronically late tasks.
* Preventive maintenance accounts for 60% of all maintenance in a typical organization.
* Calculating PM compliance can help identify areas of weakness in a preventive maintenance program and optimize resource allocation.
* PM compliance is important for preparing for audits and avoiding penalties.
* Improving PM compliance can strengthen the reliability of an organization and reduce downtime.
Sources: https://www.fiixsoftware.com/maintenance-metrics/preventive-maintenance-compliance/
